catalog.title: Record reviewed SAE qualification
catalog.mac: Research methods: Author request, review inputs, then open execution and evidence. Both CLIs use science interview/draft/publish and the same managed engine.
outputs: Diagnostic path and per-layer stability summary
catalog.restriction: Explicit config, reviewed input hashes and a fresh engine plan are required. GPU work requires immutable model revisions. Outputs are new records; local/Slurm execution uses the existing scientific owner. Native MLX numerical equivalence is not claimed. Remote training and analysis outputs are retained; the diagnostic cleanup policy does not authorize their removal.

actions.authorityReason: Inspect staged scientific inputs and execution resources without execution or authorship.
Execute a reviewed scientific operation and retain its scientific output type.

access.restriction: Calls the existing route with its existing service role and scientific gates. Request path parameters, query and body remain explicit; this adapter does not change execution topology or retry mutations.

interview.title: Record SAE feature qualification
interview.purpose: Bind declared qualification evidence to the exact imported feature.

fields.label: Reviewed qualification inputs
fields.help: Use the shipped SAE qualification template and an independent reviewer; select the completed inputs file.

interview.claimBoundary: A qualification declaration must be supported by the feature identity, dose coverage and evidence; it does not seat an agent or prove a broad construct.
questions: Who reviewed the feature identity, construct probes, sign/dose coverage and final rationale?
